pairs.subject: data-viz
pairs.evidence: src/components/report/TrendChart.tsx:46 Renders time-series trends using fixed maturity-band scales, explicit degraded/mock markings, and responsive hover tooltips without charting library overhead.

techniques.evidence: src/components/report/DimensionTrends.tsx:111 Mounts on visibility with a 200px root margin to defer loading below the fold until approached.
src/components/report/DimLine.tsx:86 Breaks the SVG path across missing data so unmeasured points render as gaps rather than plunging to zero.
src/components/report/TrendChart.tsx:210 Encodes mock and compacted points with hollow marks so data provenance and synthetic nature are distinguishable without altering the score color ramp.

src/lib/report/compare.ts:505 Tracks scoring rubric revisions between scans so historical comparisons across rubric changes explicitly identify ruler shifts rather than misattributing them to repository movement.

pairs.evidence: src/components/report/RadarChart.tsx:21 Renders multi-dimensional maturity scores as an SVG radar with zero-value markers, explicit degradation for degenerate datasets, and accessible data table fallbacks.

techniques.evidence: src/components/report/RadarChart.tsx:65 Degrades the radar chart to a labeled bar fallback when fewer than three dimensions exist rather than rendering a degenerate zero-area polygon.

src/components/report/PostureQuadrant.tsx:70 Uses a guarded linear scale mapping 0..100 domain explicitly to pixels, preventing sample-anchored floating floors.
